title: T&E Care Club
intro: The T&E Care Club at Conestoga High School is a student-led organization with 200+ members working to support needs across the Tredyffrin Township and greater the Philadelphia community.
approach_lead: Rather than deciding what communities need on our own, our approach is centered around partnership:
approach_steps: Partner with organizations already serving that population
approach_detail: Throughout the year, our members participate in service projects, community partnerships, collection drives, fundraising initiatives, and volunteer opportunities focused on different dimensions of community health.
mission_text: Each month, our club explores a different community need and works with organizations that understand that population firsthand.
